caption: The drawing depicts a botanical composition featuring a branch with multiple offshoots extending in different directions. The main branch is light brown with darker brown and red accents suggesting texture or nodes. Several leaves, colored in different shades of green, grow from the branch. There are five flowers present in the drawing: two blue flowers, one located near the top left and the other near the lower right; two pink flowers, one near the upper right and another larger one near the bottom center; and one small pink bud hanging beneath the top branch. Additionally, there is a yellowish, spiky fruit or seed pod at the top center of the composition. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is a faint, hand-drawn square framing the arrangement. The overall palette is comprised of soft, pastel colors, and the objects are outlined in thin, fine lines.
title: Applique Quilt
